---
title: "The Traitors UK: round table votes from Wikipedia"
format: html
execute:
  warning: false
  message: false
---

This document downloads the voting history table from each series' Wikipedia
page and turns it into tidy data: one table per kind of observation.

- `votes`: one row per vote cast at a round table, with each voter's (and
  target's) role at the time, and flags for double votes and revotes
- `round_tables`: one row per round table (who was banished, the published
  tally, whether it was a tie or a revote)
- `players`: one row per player (full name, how they left, when they became a
  Traitor)

Two things aren't in Wikipedia's voting table, so they are kept as short
hand-maintained lists in the second chunk: who the Traitors were and when each
one became a Traitor, and who held a double vote. Update these as a series
goes on.

A checks chunk compares the scraped votes with the tallies Wikipedia
publishes, so you can see straight away if a page's layout has changed. A
descriptive statistics chunk then summarises the voting data. The
last two chunks build a suspicion scorecard from the voting patterns that
separate Traitors from Faithfuls, test how well it works, and plot the results.

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(httr2)

# Wikipedia asks scripts to identify themselves with a descriptive user agent
wiki_user_agent <- "traitors-voting-analysis (personal R project)"

# Pause between page requests, in seconds, to be polite to Wikipedia
pause_between_pages <- 1

options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)
```

## Scrape and tidy

```{r}
#| label: scrape

# ---- Pages to scrape: add new series here --------------------------------
pages <- tribble(
  ~series, ~page,
  "UK 1",        "The_Traitors_(British_TV_series)_series_1",
  "UK 2",        "The_Traitors_(British_TV_series)_series_2",
  "UK 3",        "The_Traitors_(British_TV_series)_series_3",
  "UK 4",        "The_Traitors_(British_TV_series)_series_4",
  "Celebrity 1", "The_Celebrity_Traitors_series_1",
  "Celebrity 2", "The_Celebrity_Traitors_series_2"
)

# ---- Hand-maintained: every Traitor -----------------------------------------
# traitor_from_episode = the first episode whose round table they voted at as
# a Traitor. Original Traitors are 1. Recruits are the episode after their
# recruitment, or the same episode if they were recruited before that night's
# round table (e.g. an ultimatum in the morning).
# `name` can be a full name or the name used in the voting table.
traitors <- tribble(
  ~series,       ~name,              ~traitor_from_episode, ~how,
  "UK 1",        "Wilfred Webster",   1, "original",
  "UK 1",        "Amanda Lovett",     1, "original",
  "UK 1",        "Alyssa Chan",       1, "original",
  "UK 1",        "Kieran Tompsett",  11, "ultimatum",
  "UK 2",        "Harry Clark",       1, "original",
  "UK 2",        "Paul Gorton",       1, "original",
  "UK 2",        "Ash Bibi",          1, "original",
  "UK 2",        "Miles Asteri",      1, "recruited",
  "UK 2",        "Andrew Jenkins",    8, "recruited",
  "UK 2",        "Ross Carson",      10, "recruited",
  "UK 3",        "Armani Gouveia",    1, "original",
  "UK 3",        "Linda Rands",       1, "original",
  "UK 3",        "Minah Shannon",     1, "original",
  "UK 3",        "Charlotte Berman",  8, "ultimatum",
  "UK 3",        "Freddie Fraser",   11, "recruited",
  "UK 4",        "Rachel Duffy",      1, "original",
  "UK 4",        "Stephen Libby",     1, "original",
  "UK 4",        "Hugo Lodge",        1, "original",
  "UK 4",        "Fiona Hughes",      1, "secret",
  "Celebrity 1", "Alan Carr",         1, "original",
  "Celebrity 1", "Jonathan Ross",     1, "original",
  "Celebrity 1", "Cat Burns",         1, "original",
  "Celebrity 2", "Maya Jama",         1, "original",
  "Celebrity 2", "Richard E. Grant",  1, "original",
  "Celebrity 2", "James Acaster",     1, "recruited",
  "Celebrity 2", "Hannah Fry",        4, "recruited",
  "Celebrity 2", "King Kenny",        6, "recruited"
)

# ---- Hand-maintained: double votes (e.g. holding the dagger) -----------------
# vote_in_episode picks out one round table when an episode has more than one
# (1 = the first round table that episode). Leave it NA to cover every round
# table in the episode.
double_votes <- tribble(
  ~series,       ~episode, ~vote_in_episode, ~name,
  "UK 4",        10,       NA,               "James",
  "Celebrity 2",  8,       NA,               "King Kenny",
  "Celebrity 2",  9,        1,               "King Kenny"
)

# ---- Helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------
fetch_page <- function(page) {
  Sys.sleep(pause_between_pages)
  request(str_c("https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/", page)) %>%
    req_user_agent(wiki_user_agent) %>%
    req_retry(max_tries = 3) %>%
    req_perform() %>%
    resp_body_html()
}

# Remove footnote markers like [a] or [12] and tidy whitespace
clean_cell <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_remove_all("\\[[^\\]]*\\]") %>%
    # Wikipedia marks a double vote with "(2)" after the name, e.g. "Matthew (2)".
    # Remove it so the vote counts for Matthew. (Who held each double vote is
    # listed by hand in double_votes.)
    str_remove("\\s*\\(\\d\\)$") %>%
    str_replace_all("\\p{Pd}", "-") %>%
    str_squish()
}

# Every wikitable on the page as a character tibble. Merged cells (colspan/
# rowspan) are repeated into each column they cover.
page_tables <- function(html) {
  html %>%
    html_elements("table.wikitable") %>%
    map(\(t) html_table(t, header = FALSE, convert = FALSE) %>%
          mutate(across(everything(), clean_cell)))
}

# The voting table has row labels "Episode", "Banishment" (or "Banished") and
# "Vote" in its first column. The fire-pit table has no Banishment row.
pick_voting_table <- function(tables) {
  is_voting <- map_lgl(tables, \(d)
    any(str_detect(d[[1]], "^Episode"), na.rm = TRUE) &&
      any(str_detect(d[[1]], "^Banish"), na.rm = TRUE) &&
      any(d[[1]] == "Vote", na.rm = TRUE))
  if (!any(is_voting)) stop("No voting history table found on this page")
  candidates <- tables[is_voting]
  candidates[[which.max(map_int(candidates, nrow))]]
}

# The cast table is the one with an "Affiliation" column header
pick_cast_table <- function(tables) {
  cast <- keep(tables, \(d) any(unlist(d[1, ]) == "Affiliation", na.rm = TRUE))
  if (length(cast) == 0) return(NULL)
  cast <- cast[[1]]
  names(cast) <- make.unique(unlist(cast[1, ]))
  cast[-1, ] %>%
    transmute(full_name = .data[[names(cast)[1]]], cast_affiliation = Affiliation)
}

# Match a short name from the voting table ("Wilfred", "James A.") to a full
# name ("Wilfred Webster", "James Acaster"). Returns NA unless exactly one fits.
match_full_name <- function(short, full_names) {
  parts   <- str_match(short, "^(.+?)\\s+([A-Z])\\.?$")
  first   <- coalesce(parts[, 2], short)
  initial <- parts[, 3]
  hit <- map_lgl(str_split(full_names, "\\s+"), \(w)
    first %in% w && (is.na(initial) || any(str_starts(setdiff(w, first), initial))))
  if (sum(hit) == 1) full_names[hit] else NA_character_
}

# Attach the voting-table name (`player`) to a hand-maintained list keyed by `name`
link_to_players <- function(lookup, players) {
  lookup %>%
    inner_join(players %>% distinct(series, player), by = "series",
               relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    filter(player == name |
             map2_lgl(player, name, \(p, n) identical(match_full_name(p, n), n)))
}

fate_pattern     <- "^(Murdered|Banished|Winner|Runner-up|Eliminated|Withdrew|Left|Removed|Disqualified)"
non_vote_pattern <- "^(No ?vote|None|Immune|Shield|Ineligible|-|N/A)?$"
is_vote <- function(x) !is.na(x) & !str_detect(x, fate_pattern) & !str_detect(x, non_vote_pattern)

parse_series <- function(series, page) {
  html <- fetch_page(page)
  tabs <- page_tables(html)
  d    <- pick_voting_table(tabs)

  ep_row   <- which(str_detect(d[[1]], "^Episode"))[1]
  ban_row  <- which(str_detect(d[[1]], "^Banish"))[1]
  vote_row <- which(d[[1]] == "Vote")[1]

  # Row labels span the first few columns; player names sit in the last of them
  label_cols <- which(unlist(d[ep_row, ]) == "Episode")
  name_col   <- names(d)[max(label_cols)]
  data_cols  <- names(d)[-label_cols]

  # One row per column of the table
  columns <- tibble(
    col      = data_cols,
    episode  = as.integer(str_extract(unlist(d[ep_row, data_cols]), "^\\d+$")),
    banished = unlist(d[ban_row, data_cols]),
    tally    = str_remove_all(unlist(d[vote_row, data_cols]), "\\s")
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(episode))

  cells <- d[seq(vote_row + 1, nrow(d)), ] %>%
    rename(player = all_of(name_col)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(player), player != "") %>%
    select(player, all_of(columns$col)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-player, names_to = "col", values_to = "cell")

  # An episode is often split into two columns only because the Traitors'
  # decision row has two entries; the votes underneath are repeated. Keep one
  # copy of each distinct round table.
  columns <- cells %>%
    arrange(player) %>%
    summarise(signature = str_c(player, "=", coalesce(cell, ""), collapse = ";"), .by = col) %>%
    right_join(columns, by = "col") %>%
    mutate(signature = str_c(banished, tally, signature, sep = "|")) %>%
    distinct(episode, signature, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    select(-signature)

  cells <- cells %>% semi_join(columns, by = "col")

  votes <- cells %>%
    filter(is_vote(cell)) %>%
    select(col, voter = player, voted_for = cell)

  # Keep only columns where votes were cast, number them, and flag ties.
  # A revote is the round table straight after a tie (sometimes in the next
  # episode). A tied revote is settled by chance, not another revote.
  round_tables <- columns %>%
    semi_join(votes, by = "col") %>%
    mutate(round_table = row_number()) %>%
    mutate(vote_in_episode = row_number(), .by = episode) %>%
    mutate(tie = str_detect(banished, "^Tie"),
           revote = accumulate(lag(tie, default = FALSE),
                               \(prev_revote, prev_tie) prev_tie & !prev_revote,
                               .init = FALSE)[-1],
           series,
           banished = if_else(tie | !is_vote(banished), NA_character_, banished))

  votes <- votes %>%
    inner_join(round_tables %>% select(col, round_table, episode, vote_in_episode, revote),
               by = "col") %>%
    transmute(series, round_table, episode, vote_in_episode, revote, voter, voted_for) %>%
    arrange(round_table, voter)

  cast <- pick_cast_table(tabs)
  players <- cells %>%
    summarise(fate_text = last(cell[str_detect(coalesce(cell, ""), fate_pattern)]), .by = player) %>%
    mutate(series,
           fate = str_extract(fate_text, "^[A-Za-z-]+"),
           fate_episode = as.integer(str_extract(fate_text, "\\d+")),
           .before = 1) %>%
    select(-fate_text)

  if (!is.null(cast)) {
    players <- players %>%
      mutate(full_name = map_chr(player, match_full_name, full_names = cast$full_name)) %>%
      left_join(cast, by = "full_name")
  }

  list(
    votes = votes,
    round_tables = round_tables %>%
      select(series, round_table, episode, vote_in_episode, banished, tie, revote, tally),
    players = players
  )
}

# ---- Run it ------------------------------------------------------------------
scraped <- pages %>%
  mutate(result = map2(series, page, parse_series, .progress = TRUE))

votes        <- scraped$result %>% map("votes") %>% list_rbind()
round_tables <- scraped$result %>% map("round_tables") %>% list_rbind()
players      <- scraped$result %>% map("players") %>% list_rbind()

# ---- Add roles and double votes --------------------------------------------
traitor_links <- link_to_players(traitors, players) %>%
  select(series, player, traitor_from_episode, how_traitor = how)

double_links <- link_to_players(double_votes, players) %>%
  transmute(series, episode, dv_vote_in_episode = vote_in_episode, voter = player)

players <- players %>%
  left_join(traitor_links, by = c("series", "player")) %>%
  relocate(series, player, full_name, cast_affiliation, traitor_from_episode,
           how_traitor, fate, fate_episode)

role_at <- function(player_col, episode_col, series_col) {
  tibble(series = series_col, player = player_col, episode = episode_col) %>%
    left_join(traitor_links, by = c("series", "player")) %>%
    mutate(role = if_else(!is.na(traitor_from_episode) & episode >= traitor_from_episode,
                          "Traitor", "Faithful")) %>%
    pull(role)
}

double_vote_keys <- votes %>%
  inner_join(double_links, by = c("series", "episode", "voter"),
             relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  filter(is.na(dv_vote_in_episode) | dv_vote_in_episode == vote_in_episode) %>%
  distinct(series, round_table, voter) %>%
  mutate(double_vote = TRUE)

votes <- votes %>%
  mutate(voter_affiliation    = role_at(voter, episode, series),
         voted_for_affiliation = role_at(voted_for, episode, series)) %>%
  left_join(double_vote_keys, by = c("series", "round_table", "voter")) %>%
  mutate(double_vote = coalesce(double_vote, FALSE)) %>%
  relocate(series, round_table, episode, vote_in_episode, revote,
           voter, voter_affiliation, voted_for, voted_for_affiliation, double_vote)

votes
round_tables
players

# For analysis without tie revotes:
# votes %>% filter(!revote)

# Optional: save to CSV
# write_csv(votes, "traitors_votes.csv")
# write_csv(round_tables, "traitors_round_tables.csv")
# write_csv(players, "traitors_players.csv")
```

## Checks

```{r}
#| label: check

# 1. Round tables where the recounted votes don't match Wikipedia's "Vote" row
#    (double votes are counted twice). Anything here usually means a page's
#    layout has changed, or a double vote is missing from `double_votes`.
recomputed <- votes %>%
  count(series, round_table, voted_for, wt = if_else(double_vote, 2L, 1L)) %>%
  arrange(series, round_table, desc(n)) %>%
  summarise(recomputed = str_c(n, collapse = "-"), .by = c(series, round_table))

round_tables %>%
  left_join(recomputed, by = c("series", "round_table")) %>%
  filter(tally != recomputed)

# 2. Votes for someone who isn't a player in that series (a parsing issue)
votes %>%
  anti_join(players, by = c("series", "voted_for" = "player")) %>%
  count(series, voted_for)

# 3. Entries in the hand-maintained lists that didn't match a player
traitors %>% anti_join(link_to_players(traitors, players), by = c("series", "name"))
double_votes %>% anti_join(link_to_players(double_votes, players), by = c("series", "name"))

# 4. Players the cast table lists as Traitors who aren't in `traitors`
#    (worth checking when you add a new series)
players %>%
  filter(str_detect(coalesce(cast_affiliation, ""), "Traitor"), is.na(traitor_from_episode))
```


## Descriptive statistics

A first look at the voting data. Revotes are counted in the series overview
but left out everywhere else, because the choice is forced between the tied
players. "Traitor" and "Faithful" mean the voter's role when they voted.

```{r}
#| label: descriptives

desc_votes <- votes %>% filter(!revote)

pct <- function(x) round(100 * x, 1)

# ---- 1. Series overview -----------------------------------------------------
series_overview <- players %>%
  summarise(players = n(),
            traitors = sum(!is.na(traitor_from_episode)),
            recruited_traitors = sum(how_traitor %in% c("recruited", "ultimatum")),
            murdered = sum(fate %in% "Murdered"),
            banished = sum(fate %in% "Banished"),
            traitors_banished = sum(fate %in% "Banished" & !is.na(traitor_from_episode)),
            .by = series) %>%
  left_join(round_tables %>%
              summarise(round_tables = sum(!revote), ties = sum(tie & !revote),
                        revotes = sum(revote), .by = series),
            by = "series") %>%
  left_join(votes %>%
              summarise(votes_cast = sum(!revote), revote_votes = sum(revote),
                        double_votes = sum(double_vote), .by = series),
            by = "series")

# ---- 2. What a typical round table looks like ---------------------------------
round_table_summary <- desc_votes %>%
  count(series, round_table, episode, voted_for) %>%
  summarise(voters = sum(n), different_targets = n(), top_target_share = max(n) / sum(n),
            .by = c(series, round_table, episode))

# Every round table that ended in a banishment, revotes included
banishments <- round_tables %>%
  filter(!is.na(banished)) %>%
  left_join(traitor_links %>% select(series, banished = player, traitor_from_episode),
            by = c("series", "banished")) %>%
  mutate(banished_traitor = !is.na(traitor_from_episode) & episode >= traitor_from_episode)

round_table_by_series <- round_table_summary %>%
  summarise(round_tables = n(),
            median_voters = median(voters),
            mean_different_targets = round(mean(different_targets), 1),
            pct_votes_to_top_target = pct(mean(top_target_share)),
            pct_unanimous_or_near = pct(mean(top_target_share >= 0.8)),
            .by = series) %>%
  left_join(banishments %>%
              summarise(banishments = n(), pct_banishing_a_traitor = pct(mean(banished_traitor)),
                        .by = series),
            by = "series")

# ---- 3. Traitors' votes compared with Faithfuls' --------------------------------
tally_desc <- desc_votes %>%
  count(series, round_table, voted_for, name = "target_votes") %>%
  mutate(top = target_votes == max(target_votes), .by = c(series, round_table))

votes_by_role <- desc_votes %>%
  left_join(tally_desc, by = c("series", "round_table", "voted_for")) %>%
  left_join(round_tables %>% select(series, round_table, banished), by = c("series", "round_table")) %>%
  summarise(votes = n(),
            pct_for_top_target = pct(mean(top)),
            pct_lone_votes = pct(mean(target_votes == 1)),
            pct_for_a_traitor = pct(mean(voted_for_affiliation == "Traitor")),
            pct_for_who_was_banished = pct(mean(voted_for == coalesce(banished, ""))),
            .by = voter_affiliation)

# Faithfuls voting for a Traitor, against what random voting would give
# (Traitors' share of the other players at the table)
faithful_accuracy <- desc_votes %>%
  filter(voter_affiliation == "Faithful") %>%
  left_join(desc_votes %>%
              summarise(players = n(), traitors = sum(voter_affiliation == "Traitor"),
                        .by = c(series, round_table)),
            by = c("series", "round_table")) %>%
  summarise(faithful_votes = n(),
            pct_for_a_traitor = pct(mean(voted_for_affiliation == "Traitor")),
            pct_if_random = pct(mean(traitors / (players - 1))),
            .by = series)

# How many votes players received per round table, by their role at the time
votes_received_by_role <- desc_votes %>%
  distinct(series, round_table, episode, player = voter, role = voter_affiliation) %>%
  left_join(desc_votes %>% count(series, round_table, player = voted_for, name = "received"),
            by = c("series", "round_table", "player")) %>%
  mutate(received = coalesce(received, 0L)) %>%
  summarise(player_round_tables = n(),
            mean_votes_received = round(mean(received), 2),
            pct_received_none = pct(mean(received == 0)),
            .by = role)

# ---- 4. Players ------------------------------------------------------------------
most_voted_for <- desc_votes %>%
  count(series, player = voted_for, name = "votes_received") %>%
  left_join(players %>% select(series, player, traitor_from_episode, fate), by = c("series", "player")) %>%
  mutate(ever_traitor = !is.na(traitor_from_episode)) %>%
  select(-traitor_from_episode) %>%
  slice_max(votes_received, n = 10)

never_voted_for <- desc_votes %>%
  distinct(series, player = voter) %>%
  anti_join(desc_votes %>% distinct(series, player = voted_for), by = c("series", "player")) %>%
  left_join(players %>% select(series, player, traitor_from_episode, fate), by = c("series", "player")) %>%
  mutate(ever_traitor = !is.na(traitor_from_episode)) %>%
  select(-traitor_from_episode)

series_overview
round_table_by_series
votes_by_role
faithful_accuracy
votes_received_by_role
most_voted_for
never_voted_for
```

## Analysis: a suspicion score a Faithful could keep

The idea: every vote a player casts is evidence. Some voting behaviours are
more typical of Traitors and some of Faithfuls, so a Faithful could keep a
running score for each player, adding or taking away points after each round
table.

Only information a Faithful would have is used: who voted for whom, who was
banished and what they revealed, and who was murdered (murder victims are
always Faithful). Some behaviours can only be scored once a role is revealed,
so each one records when it becomes known (`known_after`), and the points are
added to the original vote at that point.

**Behaviours**

- *Where the vote went*: a lone vote, a minority pick, or the night's top target
- *Consistency*: repeated their last target (if still in the game) or switched
- *Who the target turned out to be*: a Traitor before they were caught, a
  Traitor on the night they were caught (first vote for them, or having voted
  for them before), a Faithful banished that night or later, or a Faithful
  later murdered
- *Agreement with revealed Traitors*: once a Traitor is revealed, whether each
  player had voted the same way as them on the night's top target or on a
  fringe pick, or differently
- *Voted for by a Traitor*: once a Traitor is revealed, the people they voted
  for on ordinary nights (when neither the Traitor nor their target left).
  This one is scored for the person who received the vote. A Traitor's parting
  vote on the night they're banished is left out, because it sometimes lands on
  a fellow Traitor

**Points** are log likelihood ratios: how much more often Traitors' votes show
a behaviour than Faithfuls' votes do, on a log scale, with `unit` log-odds per
point. "Where the vote went" is shown for interest but not scored, as earlier
work found no difference between Traitors and Faithfuls on it.

**Test**: points are learned from all series but one, then used to rank the
players before every round table in the left-out series. This is repeated for
each series in turn. Revotes and fire-pit votes are left out.

```{r}
#| label: analysis

set.seed(2026)
unit      <- 0.25   # log-odds per point (smaller = finer points)
smoothing <- 1      # added to every count so rare behaviours don't get extreme points
not_scored <- "Where the vote went"

first_votes <- votes %>%
  filter(!revote) %>%
  mutate(traitor = voter_affiliation == "Traitor")

rt_episodes <- round_tables %>% select(series, round_table, episode)

# ---- Reveals: who was shown to be what, and after which round table --------
banished_at_rt <- round_tables %>%
  filter(!is.na(banished)) %>%
  transmute(series, player = banished, how = "banished",
            reveal_episode = episode, known_after = round_table)

# Murders (revealed at breakfast, before that episode's round table) and
# banishments not settled by a vote (e.g. drawn by chance after a tied revote)
other_reveals <- players %>%
  filter(fate %in% c("Banished", "Murdered")) %>%
  anti_join(banished_at_rt, by = c("series", "player")) %>%
  transmute(series, player, how = str_to_lower(fate), reveal_episode = fate_episode) %>%
  inner_join(rt_episodes, by = "series", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  filter(if_else(how == "murdered", episode < reveal_episode, episode <= reveal_episode)) %>%
  summarise(known_after = max(round_table), .by = c(series, player, how, reveal_episode))

reveals <- bind_rows(banished_at_rt, other_reveals) %>%
  left_join(traitor_links %>% select(series, player, traitor_from_episode),
            by = c("series", "player")) %>%
  mutate(role = if_else(how == "banished" & !is.na(traitor_from_episode) &
                          reveal_episode >= traitor_from_episode, "Traitor", "Faithful"))

# ---- Behaviour of each vote --------------------------------------------------
tally <- first_votes %>%
  count(series, round_table, voted_for, wt = if_else(double_vote, 2L, 1L),
        name = "votes_received") %>%
  mutate(top = votes_received == max(votes_received), .by = c(series, round_table))

present <- first_votes %>% distinct(series, round_table, player = voter)

v <- first_votes %>%
  left_join(tally, by = c("series", "round_table", "voted_for")) %>%
  arrange(series, voter, round_table) %>%
  mutate(prev_target = lag(voted_for), .by = c(series, voter)) %>%
  mutate(voted_for_them_before = row_number() > 1, .by = c(series, voter, voted_for)) %>%
  left_join(present %>% mutate(prev_still_in = TRUE),
            by = c("series", "round_table", "prev_target" = "player")) %>%
  left_join(reveals %>% select(series, voted_for = player, t_role = role, t_how = how,
                              t_episode = reveal_episode, t_known = known_after),
            by = c("series", "voted_for"))

where_vote_went <- v %>%
  transmute(series, round_table, voter, traitor, group = "Where the vote went",
            behaviour = case_when(votes_received == 1 ~ "Cast a lone vote",
                                  top ~ "Voted for the night's top target",
                                  .default = "Voted for a minority pick"),
            known_after = round_table)

consistency <- v %>%
  filter(!is.na(prev_still_in)) %>%
  transmute(series, round_table, voter, traitor, group = "Consistency",
            behaviour = if_else(voted_for == prev_target, "Repeated their last target", "Switched target from their last vote"),
            known_after = round_table)

target_outcome <- v %>%
  filter(!is.na(t_role)) %>%
  transmute(series, round_table, voter, traitor, group = "Who the target turned out to be",
            behaviour = case_when(
              t_role == "Traitor" & t_episode == episode & !voted_for_them_before ~
                "Voted for a Traitor on the night they were caught (first vote for them)",
              t_role == "Traitor" & t_episode == episode ~
                "Voted for a Traitor on the night they were caught (had voted for them before)",
              t_role == "Traitor" ~ "Voted for a Traitor before they were caught",
              t_how == "murdered" ~ "Voted for a Faithful who was later murdered",
              t_episode == episode ~ "Voted for a Faithful who was banished that night",
              .default = "Voted for a Faithful who was banished later"),
            known_after = t_known)

revealed_traitor_votes <- v %>%
  inner_join(reveals %>% filter(role == "Traitor") %>% select(series, voter = player, rt_known = known_after),
             by = c("series", "voter")) %>%
  select(series, round_table, rt = voter, rt_target = voted_for, rt_known)

agreement <- v %>%
  inner_join(revealed_traitor_votes, by = c("series", "round_table"), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  filter(voter != rt, voted_for != rt) %>%   # voting for the Traitor is covered above
  transmute(series, round_table, voter, traitor, group = "Agreement with revealed Traitors",
            behaviour = case_when(voted_for != rt_target ~ "Voted differently from a revealed Traitor",
                                  top ~ "Matched a revealed Traitor (top target)",
                                  .default = "Matched a revealed Traitor (fringe pick)"),
            known_after = rt_known)

behaviours <- bind_rows(where_vote_went, consistency, target_outcome, agreement)

# Voted for by a Traitor: scored for the person who RECEIVED the vote, so here
# `voter` is the player being scored. Ordinary nights only: neither the Traitor
# nor their target was banished that episode.
banished_ep <- reveals %>% filter(how == "banished") %>% select(series, player, banished_episode = reveal_episode)

voted_for_by_traitor <- v %>%
  filter(traitor) %>%
  inner_join(reveals %>% filter(role == "Traitor") %>%
               select(series, voter = player, rt_known = known_after),
             by = c("series", "voter")) %>%
  left_join(banished_ep %>% rename(voter = player, voter_banished = banished_episode),
            by = c("series", "voter")) %>%
  left_join(banished_ep %>% rename(voted_for = player, target_banished = banished_episode),
            by = c("series", "voted_for")) %>%
  filter(coalesce(voter_banished != episode, TRUE), coalesce(target_banished != episode, TRUE)) %>%
  transmute(series, round_table, voter = voted_for, traitor = voted_for_affiliation == "Traitor",
            group = "Voted for by a Traitor",
            behaviour = "Voted for by a revealed Traitor on a night neither of them left",
            known_after = rt_known)

scored_behaviours <- bind_rows(behaviours, voted_for_by_traitor)

# ---- Points ------------------------------------------------------------------
points_from <- function(b) {
  b %>%
    count(group, behaviour, traitor) %>%
    complete(nesting(group, behaviour), traitor, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = traitor, values_from = n, names_prefix = "n_") %>%
    mutate(k = n(),
           traitor_rate  = n_TRUE / sum(n_TRUE),
           faithful_rate = n_FALSE / sum(n_FALSE),
           llr = log(((n_TRUE + smoothing) / (sum(n_TRUE) + smoothing * k)) /
                       ((n_FALSE + smoothing) / (sum(n_FALSE) + smoothing * k))),
           .by = group) %>%
    mutate(points = if_else(group %in% not_scored, 0, round(llr / unit))) %>%
    select(group, behaviour, traitor_votes = n_TRUE, faithful_votes = n_FALSE,
           traitor_rate, faithful_rate, llr, points)
}

# Points for being voted for by a Traitor. There is no "other" category to compare
# with, so compare how often Traitors and Faithfuls receive such a vote per round
# table they attend (each first vote cast = one player at one round table).
received_points_from <- function(r, fv) {
  exposure <- fv %>% count(traitor, name = "exposure")
  r %>%
    count(group, behaviour, traitor) %>%
    complete(nesting(group, behaviour), traitor = c(FALSE, TRUE), fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
    left_join(exposure, by = "traitor") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = traitor, values_from = c(n, exposure)) %>%
    transmute(group, behaviour, traitor_votes = n_TRUE, faithful_votes = n_FALSE,
              traitor_rate = n_TRUE / exposure_TRUE, faithful_rate = n_FALSE / exposure_FALSE,
              llr = log(((n_TRUE + smoothing) / (exposure_TRUE + 2 * smoothing)) /
                          ((n_FALSE + smoothing) / (exposure_FALSE + 2 * smoothing))),
              points = round(llr / unit),
              p_value = fisher.test(matrix(c(n_TRUE, exposure_TRUE - n_TRUE,
                                             n_FALSE, exposure_FALSE - n_FALSE), 2))$p.value)
}

# All points (both kinds), learned from a chosen set of series
all_points_from <- function(use_series) {
  bind_rows(points_from(behaviours %>% filter(series %in% use_series)),
            received_points_from(voted_for_by_traitor %>% filter(series %in% use_series),
                                 first_votes %>% filter(series %in% use_series)) %>%
              select(-p_value))
}

scorecard <- points_from(behaviours) %>%
  mutate(p_value = pmap_dbl(list(group, traitor_votes, faithful_votes), \(g, t, f) {
    tot <- behaviours %>% filter(group == g) %>% count(traitor)
    fisher.test(matrix(c(t, tot$n[tot$traitor] - t, f, tot$n[!tot$traitor] - f), 2))$p.value
  })) %>%
  bind_rows(received_points_from(voted_for_by_traitor, first_votes))

# ---- Running score before each round table -----------------------------------
# Every player at a round table, scored on behaviours from earlier round tables
# whose information was known by then.
score_before <- function(b, cands, pts) {
  b %>%
    inner_join(pts %>% select(group, behaviour, points), by = c("group", "behaviour")) %>%
    filter(points != 0) %>%
    select(series, player = voter, b_rt = round_table, known_after, points) %>%
    right_join(cands, by = c("series", "player"), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    mutate(points = if_else(!is.na(b_rt) & b_rt < round_table & known_after < round_table,
                            points, 0)) %>%
    summarise(score = sum(points), .by = c(series, round_table, player, traitor))
}

round_metrics <- function(scored) {
  scored %>%
    summarise(
      players = n(), traitors = sum(traitor),
      top_suspect_traitor = mean(traitor[score == max(score)]),
      top3_has_traitor = mean(replicate(200, {
        o <- order(-score, runif(n()))
        any(traitor[o[seq_len(min(3, n()))]])
      })),
      auc = mean(outer(score[traitor], score[!traitor], ">") +
                   0.5 * outer(score[traitor], score[!traitor], "==")),
      .by = c(series, round_table)) %>%
    mutate(chance_top_suspect = traitors / players,
           chance_top3 = 1 - choose(players - traitors, pmin(3, players)) /
             choose(players, pmin(3, players)))
}

# Round tables to test on: not the first of a series (nothing to go on yet),
# and only where there is at least one Traitor and one Faithful
candidates <- first_votes %>% distinct(series, round_table, player = voter, traitor)
eval_candidates <- candidates %>%
  filter(round_table > min(round_table), .by = series) %>%
  filter(any(traitor) & any(!traitor), .by = c(series, round_table))

# Leave each series out in turn (keep each player's score for the round-by-round view)
heldout_scores <- unique(candidates$series) %>%
  map(\(s) score_before(scored_behaviours %>% filter(series == s),
                        eval_candidates %>% filter(series == s),
                        all_points_from(setdiff(unique(candidates$series), s)))) %>%
  list_rbind()

heldout <- round_metrics(heldout_scores)

# How often the real round table's top target was a Traitor, for comparison
table_hit <- first_votes %>%
  semi_join(tally %>% filter(top), by = c("series", "round_table", "voted_for")) %>%
  distinct(series, round_table, voted_for, voted_for_affiliation) %>%
  summarise(real_table_hit = mean(voted_for_affiliation == "Traitor"), .by = c(series, round_table))

summarise_heldout <- function(d) {
  d %>%
    left_join(table_hit, by = c("series", "round_table")) %>%
    summarise(round_tables = n(),
              top_suspect_traitor = mean(top_suspect_traitor),
              chance_top_suspect = mean(chance_top_suspect),
              top3_has_traitor = mean(top3_has_traitor),
              chance_top3 = mean(chance_top3),
              auc = mean(auc),
              real_table_hit = mean(real_table_hit))
}

heldout_overall <- summarise_heldout(heldout)
heldout_by_series <- heldout %>% group_by(series) %>% summarise_heldout() %>% ungroup()
heldout_by_stage <- heldout %>%
  mutate(stage = if_else(round_table <= 4, "Round tables 2-4", "Round table 5 onwards"),
         .by = series) %>%
  group_by(stage) %>% summarise_heldout() %>% ungroup()

# ---- Standings in the most recent series, before the next round table --------
# Points come from the other series, so this is a fair test of that series.
focus_series <- last(pages$series)
focus_last_rt <- max(candidates$round_table[candidates$series == focus_series])

focus_standings <- score_before(
  scored_behaviours %>% filter(series == focus_series),
  candidates %>% filter(series == focus_series, round_table == focus_last_rt),
  all_points_from(setdiff(unique(candidates$series), focus_series))
) %>%
  arrange(desc(score))

scorecard %>% select(group, behaviour, traitor_rate, faithful_rate, points, p_value)
heldout_overall
heldout_by_series
heldout_by_stage
focus_standings
```

## Performance at each round table

The held-out test above, broken down round table by round table. For each one
it shows who the scorecard would have named as top suspect (using points
learned from the other series and only what was known at the time), where
each Traitor ranked, how many Traitors had been revealed by then (the main
source of evidence), and whether the round table itself voted for a Traitor.

`round_table_number` counts only first votes, so revotes don't shift the
numbering, which makes round tables comparable across series.

```{r}
#| label: round-by-round

rt_numbering <- round_tables %>%
  filter(!revote) %>%
  mutate(round_table_number = row_number(), .by = series) %>%
  select(series, round_table, round_table_number, episode, banished)

traitors_revealed_by <- function(s, rt) {
  sum(reveals$series == s & reveals$role == "Traitor" & reveals$known_after < rt)
}

# Rank 1 = top suspect; "=" marks a rank shared with other players
heldout_by_round_table <- heldout_scores %>%
  mutate(rank = min_rank(desc(score)),
         rank_label = str_c(rank, if_else(duplicated(score) | duplicated(score, fromLast = TRUE), "=", "")),
         .by = c(series, round_table)) %>%
  summarise(
    players = n(),
    traitors = sum(traitor),
    top_suspects = str_c(player[score == max(score)], collapse = ", "),
    top_score = max(score),
    traitor_ranks = str_c(player[traitor], " (", rank_label[traitor], ")", collapse = ", "),
    best_traitor_rank = min(rank[traitor]),
    best_traitor_rank_label = rank_label[traitor][which.min(rank[traitor])],
    .by = c(series, round_table)
  ) %>%
  left_join(heldout %>% select(series, round_table, top_suspect_traitor, chance_top_suspect,
                               top3_has_traitor, auc),
            by = c("series", "round_table")) %>%
  left_join(table_hit, by = c("series", "round_table")) %>%
  left_join(rt_numbering, by = c("series", "round_table")) %>%
  mutate(traitors_revealed_so_far = map2_int(series, round_table, traitors_revealed_by),
         series = fct_inorder(series)) %>%
  relocate(series, round_table_number, episode, players, traitors, traitors_revealed_so_far,
           top_suspects, top_score, traitor_ranks, best_traitor_rank, top_suspect_traitor,
           chance_top_suspect, top3_has_traitor, auc, real_table_hit, banished) %>%
  arrange(series, round_table_number)

# The same, pooled across series by round table number
performance_by_round_table_number <- heldout_by_round_table %>%
  summarise(series = n(),
            top_suspect_traitor = mean(top_suspect_traitor),
            chance_top_suspect = mean(chance_top_suspect),
            top3_has_traitor = mean(top3_has_traitor),
            real_table_hit = mean(real_table_hit),
            mean_traitors_revealed = mean(traitors_revealed_so_far),
            .by = round_table_number) %>%
  arrange(round_table_number)

# ...and by how many Traitors had been revealed so far
performance_by_traitors_revealed <- heldout_by_round_table %>%
  mutate(traitors_revealed = if_else(traitors_revealed_so_far >= 3, "3 or more",
                                     as.character(traitors_revealed_so_far))) %>%
  summarise(round_tables = n(),
            top_suspect_traitor = mean(top_suspect_traitor),
            chance_top_suspect = mean(chance_top_suspect),
            top3_has_traitor = mean(top3_has_traitor),
            auc = mean(auc),
            .by = traitors_revealed) %>%
  arrange(traitors_revealed)

# From a Faithful's own seat: they know they're Faithful, so they rank everyone
# except themselves. Averaged over every Faithful at every round table.
faithful_view <- heldout_scores %>%
  filter(!traitor) %>%
  distinct(series, round_table, me = player) %>%
  inner_join(heldout_scores, by = c("series", "round_table"), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  filter(player != me) %>%
  summarise(top_suspect_traitor = mean(traitor[score == max(score)]),
            chance_top_suspect = mean(traitor),
            .by = c(series, round_table, me)) %>%
  # average over the Faithfuls at each round table, then over round tables,
  # so every round table counts equally (as in the other results)
  summarise(top_suspect_traitor = mean(top_suspect_traitor),
            chance_top_suspect = mean(chance_top_suspect), .by = c(series, round_table)) %>%
  summarise(top_suspect_traitor = mean(top_suspect_traitor),
            chance_top_suspect = mean(chance_top_suspect))

heldout_by_round_table %>% print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
performance_by_round_table_number
performance_by_traitors_revealed
faithful_view
```

## Murders: who do the Traitors choose?

The Traitors know everyone's role, so their choice of victim shows who they
see as a threat. For each murder, the pool is every Faithful still in the game
after the previous episode's round table. Each behaviour is compared against
what you would expect if the Traitors picked from that pool at random: a risk
of 1.5 means 50% more likely to be murdered than chance. P-values come from
reshuffling who was murdered within each night.

Behaviours are taken from the previous episode's round table(s), plus each
Faithful's suspicion score at that point, as the rest of the table would see
it.

```{r}
#| label: murders

set.seed(2026)
n_murder_shuffles <- 5000

rt_votes <- votes %>% filter(!revote)

# Episodes with a round table, and the last one before each murder
rt_eps <- round_tables %>% distinct(series, episode)

murders <- players %>%
  filter(fate %in% "Murdered") %>%
  transmute(series, victim = player, murder_episode = fate_episode) %>%
  inner_join(rt_eps %>% rename(prev_ep = episode), by = "series", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  filter(prev_ep < murder_episode) %>%
  slice_max(prev_ep, n = 1, by = c(series, victim))

banished_in_ep <- players %>%
  filter(fate %in% "Banished") %>%
  select(series, player, banished_ep = fate_episode)

# Behaviour of every Faithful at each episode's round table(s)
traitors_then <- rt_votes %>%
  distinct(series, episode, player = voter, role = voter_affiliation)

ep_behaviour <- rt_votes %>%
  left_join(tally %>% select(series, round_table, voted_for, target_votes = votes_received, top),
            by = c("series", "round_table", "voted_for")) %>%
  left_join(banished_in_ep %>% rename(voted_for = player), by = c("series", "voted_for")) %>%
  mutate(target_survived = is.na(banished_ep) | banished_ep != episode) %>%
  left_join(rt_votes %>%
              filter(voter_affiliation == "Traitor") %>%
              distinct(series, round_table, traitor = voter, traitor_target = voted_for),
            by = c("series", "round_table"), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  summarise(
    accused_surviving_traitor = any(voted_for_affiliation == "Traitor" & target_survived),
    voted_with_a_traitor      = any(voted_for == traitor_target & voter != traitor, na.rm = TRUE),
    voted_with_the_room       = any(top),
    lone_vote                 = any(target_votes == 1),
    .by = c(series, episode, voter)
  ) %>%
  rename(player = voter)

received <- rt_votes %>% count(series, episode, player = voted_for, name = "votes_received")

# Ever voted for someone who is a Traitor still in the game
ever_accused <- rt_votes %>%
  filter(voted_for_affiliation == "Traitor") %>%
  select(series, player = voter, target = voted_for, vote_ep = episode) %>%
  inner_join(rt_eps, by = "series", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  filter(vote_ep <= episode) %>%
  left_join(banished_in_ep %>% rename(target = player), by = c("series", "target")) %>%
  filter(is.na(banished_ep) | banished_ep > episode) %>%
  distinct(series, episode, player) %>%
  mutate(ever_accused_live_traitor = TRUE)

# Suspicion score as the table would see it after that episode's round tables,
# turned into a within-night percentile (0 = most cleared, 1 = most suspected)
murder_scores <- function(pool) {
  cands <- pool %>%
    distinct(series, prev_ep, player) %>%
    left_join(round_tables %>% summarise(last_rt = max(round_table), .by = c(series, episode)),
              by = c("series", "prev_ep" = "episode")) %>%
    mutate(round_table = last_rt + 1, traitor = FALSE)
  score_before(scored_behaviours, cands %>% select(series, round_table, player, traitor),
               all_points_from(unique(candidates$series))) %>%
    left_join(cands %>% distinct(series, round_table, prev_ep), by = c("series", "round_table")) %>%
    distinct(series, prev_ep, player, score)
}

pool <- traitors_then %>%
  semi_join(murders, by = c("series", "episode" = "prev_ep")) %>%
  filter(role == "Faithful") %>%
  anti_join(banished_in_ep, by = c("series", "player", "episode" = "banished_ep")) %>%
  rename(prev_ep = episode) %>%
  left_join(murders %>% select(series, prev_ep, player = victim) %>% mutate(murdered = TRUE),
            by = c("series", "prev_ep", "player")) %>%
  left_join(ep_behaviour, by = c("series", "prev_ep" = "episode", "player")) %>%
  left_join(received, by = c("series", "prev_ep" = "episode", "player")) %>%
  left_join(ever_accused, by = c("series", "prev_ep" = "episode", "player")) %>%
  mutate(across(c(murdered, accused_surviving_traitor, voted_with_a_traitor, voted_with_the_room,
                  lone_vote, ever_accused_live_traitor), \(x) coalesce(x, FALSE)),
         under_suspicion = coalesce(votes_received, 0L) > 0)

pool <- pool %>%
  left_join(murder_scores(pool), by = c("series", "prev_ep", "player")) %>%
  mutate(score_percentile = (rank(score, ties.method = "average") - 1) / pmax(n() - 1, 1),
         most_cleared_third = score_percentile <= 1/3,
         most_suspected_third = score_percentile >= 2/3,
         .by = c(series, prev_ep)) %>%
  mutate(pool_size = n(), murders_tonight = sum(murdered), .by = c(series, prev_ep))

murders_covered <- murders %>%
  left_join(pool %>% filter(murdered) %>% distinct(series, player, prev_ep) %>% mutate(in_pool = TRUE),
            by = c("series", "victim" = "player", "prev_ep")) %>%
  summarise(murders = n(), analysed = sum(!is.na(in_pool)))

# Observed vs expected murders for each behaviour, with a reshuffle p-value
night_index <- split(seq_len(nrow(pool)), interaction(pool$series, pool$prev_ep, drop = TRUE))
shuffled_murders <- replicate(n_murder_shuffles, {
  m <- logical(nrow(pool))
  for (i in night_index) m[sample(i, sum(pool$murdered[i]))] <- TRUE
  m
})

murder_behaviours <- c(
  "Voted for a Traitor who survived the vote" = "accused_surviving_traitor",
  "Has voted for a Traitor still in the game" = "ever_accused_live_traitor",
  "Voted the same way as a Traitor"           = "voted_with_a_traitor",
  "Voted for the night's top target"          = "voted_with_the_room",
  "Cast a lone vote"                          = "lone_vote",
  "Received votes themselves"                 = "under_suspicion",
  "Among the most cleared third (score)"      = "most_cleared_third",
  "Among the most suspected third (score)"    = "most_suspected_third"
)

murder_risk <- imap(murder_behaviours, \(col, label) {
  x <- pool[[col]]
  observed <- sum(pool$murdered & x)
  expected <- sum((pool$murders_tonight / pool$pool_size)[x])
  null <- colSums(shuffled_murders & x)
  tibble(behaviour = label,
         faithful_nights = sum(x),
         murdered = observed,
         expected = round(expected, 1),
         risk = round(observed / expected, 2),
         p_value = round((sum(abs(null - mean(null)) >= abs(observed - mean(null))) + 1) /
                           (n_murder_shuffles + 1), 3))
}) %>%
  list_rbind()

# Average suspicion-score percentile of the people murdered (0.5 = random)
victim_percentile <- pool %>%
  filter(murdered) %>%
  summarise(victims = n(), mean_percentile = round(mean(score_percentile), 2))

murders_covered
murder_risk
victim_percentile
```

## Plots

```{r}
#| label: plots
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6

role_colours <- c("More typical of Traitors" = "#B3261E", "More typical of Faithfuls" = "#3B6E8F")

# 1. The scorecard, ranked from most typical of Traitors (top) to least (bottom)
scorecard %>%
  mutate(label = str_c(behaviour, "  (", traitor_votes, " T / ", faithful_votes, " F)"),
         label = fct_reorder(label, llr),   # highest log-odds at the top
         side = if_else(llr > 0, "More typical of Traitors", "More typical of Faithfuls"),
         points_text = case_when(group %in% not_scored ~ "not scored",
                                 points == 0 ~ "0",
                                 .default = sprintf("%+d", as.integer(points)))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(llr, label, fill = side)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_text(aes(label = points_text, hjust = if_else(llr > 0, -0.2, 1.2)), size = 3.3) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.2)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = role_colours) +
  labs(title = "How much each voting behaviour should shift your suspicion",
       subtitle = str_c("Log likelihood ratio per vote. Labels show points (1 point = ",
                        unit, " log-odds).\nCounts are Traitor votes / Faithful votes (votes received for the 'voted for by' row)."),
       x = "Log-odds shift", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        plot.title.position = "plot")

# 2. Held-out test: how often the top suspect was a Traitor
heldout_by_series %>%
  bind_rows(heldout_overall %>% mutate(series = "All series")) %>%
  mutate(series = fct_rev(fct_inorder(series))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = series)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = chance_top_suspect, xend = top_suspect_traitor, yend = series), colour = "grey60") +
  geom_point(aes(x = chance_top_suspect, colour = "Chance"), size = 3) +
  geom_point(aes(x = real_table_hit, colour = "Real round table's choice"), size = 3, shape = 17) +
  geom_point(aes(x = top_suspect_traitor, colour = "Score's top suspect"), size = 3.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Chance" = "grey55", "Real round table's choice" = "#E0A100",
                                 "Score's top suspect" = "#B3261E")) +
  labs(title = "How often the top suspect was a Traitor",
       subtitle = "Each series scored with points learned from the other series, before every round table",
       x = "Round tables where the pick was a Traitor", y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())

# 3. Standings in the most recent series before its last round table
focus_standings %>%
  mutate(player = fct_reorder(player, score),
         role = if_else(traitor, "Traitor (known to viewers)", "Faithful")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(score, player, colour = role)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey70") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = score, yend = player), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = score, hjust = if_else(score < 0, 2.2, -1.2)), size = 3.4, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.2)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Traitor (known to viewers)" = "#B3261E", "Faithful" = "#3B6E8F")) +
  labs(title = str_c(focus_series, ": suspicion scores before the last round table"),
       subtitle = "Points learned from the other series. Higher = more suspicious.",
       x = "Suspicion score", y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())

# 4. Murders: which Faithfuls were murdered more or less often than chance
murder_risk %>%
  mutate(behaviour = fct_reorder(behaviour, risk),
         label = str_c(murdered, " murdered vs ", expected, " expected (p = ", p_value, ")")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(risk, behaviour)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = 2, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 1, xend = risk, yend = behaviour), colour = "grey70") +
  geom_point(aes(colour = risk > 1), size = 3.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), nudge_y = 0.32, size = 3, colour = "grey30") +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5, 2), limits = c(0.5, 2)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#B3261E", "FALSE" = "#3B6E8F")) +
  labs(title = "Which Faithfuls get murdered?",
       subtitle = "Murder risk against picking a Faithful at random each night (1 = no difference)",
       x = "Murder risk (log scale)", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())

# 5. Round by round, pooled across series: how accuracy builds up over a game
performance_by_round_table_number %>%
  filter(series >= 3) %>%
  select(round_table_number, series, `Score's top suspect` = top_suspect_traitor,
         `Real round table's choice` = real_table_hit, Chance = chance_top_suspect) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(round_table_number, series), names_to = "pick", values_to = "hit_rate") %>%
  ggplot(aes(round_table_number, hit_rate, colour = pick)) +
  geom_line(aes(linetype = pick == "Chance"), linewidth = 0.9, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:20) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Score's top suspect" = "#B3261E",
                                 "Real round table's choice" = "#E0A100",
                                 "Chance" = "grey55")) +
  labs(title = "How often the pick was a Traitor, round table by round table",
       subtitle = "Averaged across series; round table numbers reached by at least three series",
       x = "Round table number (first votes only)", y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# 6. Every round table in every series: was the top suspect a Traitor?
heldout_by_round_table %>%
  mutate(label = best_traitor_rank_label,
         series = fct_rev(series)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(round_table_number, series, fill = top_suspect_traitor)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), size = 3.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2:max(heldout_by_round_table$round_table_number)) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#EDEDED", high = "#B3261E", labels = scales::label_percent(),
                      limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(title = "Was the scorecard's top suspect a Traitor?",
       subtitle = "Each tile is one round table. Shade = share of joint top suspects who were Traitors.\nNumber = rank of the highest-placed Traitor (1 = top suspect, = means tied).",
       x = "Round table number (first votes only)", y = NULL, fill = "Top suspect\na Traitor") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), plot.title.position = "plot")
```
